summary: Implemented provider property validation-error, submitted, rejected, approved/published, and hidden-state views for PRV-11 through PRV-14. The UI derives validation issues from the current property contract, uses only the implemented provider property GET route, preserves API availableActions and ownership boundaries, and avoids exposing internal reviewer identifiers, private documents, storage keys, or unsupported view metrics.

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified as the direct route integration exception required to render the selected state routes.

The validation view mirrors the current API validation rules for location, price, contact, and draft/needs_changes status; it performs no mutation and links to edit only when availableActions includes update.
Published view metrics are rendered as unavailable because the current provider property contract exposes no view-count metric; no fabricated operational number was added.
Approved and hidden provider statuses use the existing published-state route mapping; no unsupported new state screen was invented.
The adjacent provider-property completion E2E test received a no-behavior unused-variable cleanup required for the repository lint gate.
The in-app browser connector was unavailable because its sandbox metadata was missing; executable Playwright visual, keyboard, focus, and permission journeys passed.
knownGaps: No provider support route is implemented, so rejected states without an available update action expose an honest unavailable action rather than an invented destination.
No direct in-app browser connector evidence was available; this task does not claim a browser-connector pass.
This task does not claim full API, Backend, screen, or platform completion.
